name: Okano Mana
source:
The youngest sister of the Okano family.

She's a late blooming girl who dislikes Ryouta for suddenly living with her family. She is somewhat ambivalent towards him. She is naturally shy and reserved.

She is a rather serious and firm person in the family, but she has an extremely bad sleeping habit.

Her birthday is a month earlier than Ryouta's. Deep down, Mana is probably the most pleased with Ryouta's arrival because it means she can get rid of her status as the youngest child.

From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/matty.html]official site[/url].
